scope: source-registration acceptance benchmark; no key derivation

constraints.name: trusted source boxes
constraints.requirement: Use trusted high-res O5 and corrected trusted G5, not stale projected p76_grey_5 geometry.
constraints.acceptance: Any future source transform must report target boxes against these trusted units or a clearly better manual source.

constraints.name: p78 frame signature
constraints.requirement: Explain current O5 bottom/left clip, trusted G5 38px near-edge relation, and the dx=-40 repair without arbitrary local fitting.
constraints.evidence: Current O5 overlap=0.24754; G5 gap=38.0px; nearest simultaneous repair dx=-40, dy=0.
constraints.acceptance: A valid source registration should naturally make this signature coherent while preserving the same corridor.

constraints.name: extraction unit
constraints.requirement: Name a word, letter, line, edge, pixel, font-state, or ordering unit before any key derivation.
constraints.evidence: Gap-repaired p78 streams produce instruction hits: none.
constraints.acceptance: Must produce a human-readable instruction or checksum-valid compact key-like unit from a rule that follows from source/clue evidence.

constraints.name: physical leaf/spread support
constraints.requirement: True physical page relationships should improve, not degrade, O5/G5 targeting.
constraints.evidence: Current best-scan physical models have total trusted O5/G5 direct overlaps=0.
constraints.acceptance: A physical scan/photo should show real front/back, spread, bleed-through, or fold behavior that selects the corridor.

constraints.name: opener capsule provenance
constraints.requirement: Preserve the real p73->p79 five-capsule artwork reuse while avoiding loose forced M3/M4 assignment.
constraints.evidence: Current endpoint sequence=M3M3M4M4M4; tight <=75px assigns 1/5, <=150px assigns 2/5.
constraints.acceptance: A new transform should place all five ordered capsules tightly on text/selector units, or provide an explicit clue for M3/M4 binary/index use.

constraints.name: five-index locator
constraints.requirement: Preserve the repeated five system without treating five, RRLL, or 1100 as key material by itself.
constraints.evidence: Five repeats across p73/p79/p80/p76; p73/p79 step signature=RRLL / RRLL; p79-p73 offsets=[5, 5, 5, 5, 5]; instruction hits=none.
constraints.acceptance: A future source/clue must explain how five selects a unit such as word/letter/edge/font before extraction resumes.

constraints.name: announcement media coverage
constraints.requirement: Use public media sequence as target confirmation, not overclaim it as exact order.
constraints.evidence: Media order unique page-76 initials=PpvV; missing units=buying_dip, one_billion, imf_loan.
constraints.acceptance: Future use of media must add a new exact unit/order not already covered by page-76 Bukele/volcano targeting.

constraints.name: Canva/source image quality
constraints.requirement: Do not use the 668x376 Canva thumbnail as geometry truth.
constraints.evidence: Current Canva witness is thumbnail-scale ([668, 376]) and documented as an investigator note board.
constraints.acceptance: Need original embedded assets, higher-resolution export, browser screenshot, or physical source image.

constraints.name: orientation/source cache bridge
constraints.requirement: Compare future source images in the correct orientation before judging geometry.
constraints.evidence: Current 3D/readable layer matches source/PDF after `rotate180`; priority crop RMS range=1.132865 to 2.070533.
constraints.acceptance: Use readable/upright geometry or rotate native source/PDF images 180 degrees before applying page-76 crop coordinates.

witnesses.name: current best high-res magazine.pdf
witnesses.verdict: Good for target discovery and source provenance; insufficient for precise extraction.

witnesses.name: current p78 dx=-40 local repair
witnesses.verdict: Useful only as a future registration signature; it does not change the instruction-free phrase stream.

witnesses.name: Canva 668x376 note board
witnesses.verdict: Orientation/provenance clue only; too small and secondary for measurement.

witnesses.name: announcement media sequence
witnesses.verdict: Confirms page 76/Bukele/volcano area, but not exact order or unit.

witnesses.name: future physical/source scan
witnesses.verdict: Highest-value missing evidence: must be tested against C1-C9 before new extraction.

decision: Do not promote new local geometry streams unless they pass C2/C3 and explain C6; current local sources fail the extraction-unit requirement.
nextMove: Acquire or inspect a better source image/physical scan, then score it against this benchmark before extracting words/letters.
